name: capability-reel
about: A 15-25 s launch close (or a short launch film on its own): one line inside a ring of sources, the page darkening as a ring becomes a disc that grows into one real record, a statement on a light card that squashes round its line, a ticker through what the product returns, the big claim on the accent in two beats, a graphic transition out of its full stop, and the end card. new-film.sh --template capability-reel lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every reel is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): its cuts and swaps sit on the track's drum onsets and earshot effects mark the state changes; never effects only.
music.pick: the dealt direction lists tracks from the shortlist in its tempo range (python3 scripts/deck.py --show); 115-130 BPM with a punchy kick suits the template's cuts on kicks
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template capability-reel --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
